note: Wikimedia Commons, “Agios Germanos Konstantinoupoleos Vissarionos.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Tzortzis Phouka — fetched 04 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it «Fresco of Saint Germanos of Constantinople from Saint Bessarion's Monastery», a sixteenth-century fresco by Tzortzis Phouka, and files it under its category 'Germanos I of Constantinople' — the first of that name, the patriarch who resigned under Leo the Isaurian. That is this folder: saint.gr prints «Άγιος Γερμανός Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης» for 12 May and doxologia.ro «Sfântul Ierarh Gherman, Patriarhul Constantinopolului» for the same day, which is Germanus I's and not Germanus II's. Commons describes it: Fresco of Saint Germanos of Constantinople from Saint Bessarion's Monastery
